hero.lead: Log every fill-up in liters or gallons, unify your spending in pesos and dollars with official DOF exchange rates, and discover your vehicles' real efficiency in one place.

features.title: Everything you need for your vehicle logbook
features.subtitle: Designed to simplify data entry, automate complex conversions and deliver reliable analytics without friction.

logging.title: Fuel logbook
logging.text: Log each fill-up with odometer reading, volume, total cost and notes. The system accurately calculates distance traveled and efficiency for every tank.

currency.title: USD/MXN multi-currency
currency.text: Pay in dollars in the U.S. or pesos in Mexico. AutoLog stores both the original cost and the cost normalized to the base currency for consistent, comparable analysis.

dof.title: Official DOF sync
dof.text: Direct integration with Mexico's Diario Oficial de la Federación (DOF) to auto-fill the official exchange rate for the exact date of your fill-up.

units.title: Unit normalization
units.text: Full support for metric and imperial systems: enter miles or kilometers, liters or gallons. AutoLog standardizes calculations without altering your original records.

dashboard.title: Metrics and dashboard
dashboard.text: View interactive charts with historical efficiency (km/L), year-over-year comparisons and accumulated monthly spending trends for each vehicle.

security.title: Security and privacy
security.text: Your data is protected with BCrypt password hashing, JWT authentication with refresh tokens and strict per-owner access control.

border.title: Designed for life on the border
border.lead: Living near the border means filling up sometimes in Mexico and sometimes in the United States. Constantly switching between gallons and liters, dollars and pesos ruins any attempt at an accurate logbook.

noManual.title: No manual conversions
noManual.text: Enter data exactly as it appears on your gas station receipt. The system normalizes everything automatically.

traceability.title: Full dual-currency traceability
traceability.text: Check at any time what you paid in the original currency and which official rate was applied.

multiVehicle.title: Multi-vehicle
multiVehicle.text: Manage all of your family's or business's vehicles from a single centralized account.

one.title: You fill up
one.text: Enter odometer, liters/gallons and amount in pesos or dollars.

two.title: Automatic sync
two.text: If you paid in USD, AutoLog fetches the official DOF exchange rate for the selected date.

three.title: Efficiency calculation
three.text: The system instantly updates efficiency (km/L) between fill-ups and refreshes your statistics.

contact.title: Get in touch
contact.subtitle: Have questions, feature ideas or need help with your account? Write to us and we'll gladly help.

footer.description: Full-stack system for thorough fuel tracking, unit normalization and USD/MXN dual-currency management with official DOF data.
